title: VacantHouseListing
description: One property a municipality offers on its akiya bank (空き家バンク) for sale or rent: what is offered, at what price, and the state of the deal. Built on the akiya bank registration items of MLIT's 空き家データベースシステム標準仕様書 (version 1.0, April 2025)

@context.description: JSON-LD context of the entity, optional: a context URL or a list of context URLs

vacantHouse.description: The vacant house in the municipality's register that this listing is for, when the register is kept as VacantHouse entities

localGovernmentCode.description: Local government code of the municipality that runs the akiya bank (全国地方公共団体コード, 6 digits)

listingNumber.description: Number of the property in the akiya bank or real estate information platform (不動産情報プラットフォーム・バンク登録番号, D0035)

name.description: Title of the listing as shown on the akiya bank

address.description: Address of the property as published, as a JapaneseAddress value (common subject). It may stop at the town (町字) when the municipality does not publish the full address

location.description: Where the property is, as a point. It may be moved or rounded when the municipality does not publish the exact place

listedOn.description: Day the property was put on the akiya bank (登録年月日)

withdrawnOn.description: Day the listing was taken off the akiya bank (取消年月日)

dealStatus.description: State of the deal (取引状況ステータスコード, MLIT code 044): available (001 取引なし), negotiating (002 交渉中), contracted (003 成約済み). When no value fits, leave it out and give the local wording in statusLabel

statusLabel.description: The deal state in the akiya bank's own wording (受付中, 商談中, 成約済み). Required when dealStatus is left out

offerType.description: Whether the property is offered for sale, for rent or both

contractType.description: Kind of contract once contracted (成約形態管理コード, MLIT code 045): sale (001 売買成約), rent (002 賃貸成約)

salePrice.description: Asking price in yen for land and building together (所有者等希望売買価格, the land and building items added up)

monthlyRent.description: Asking rent per month in yen for land and building together (所有者等希望賃貸価格, the land and building items added up)

agentName.description: Name of the real estate agent that handles the listing (事業者)

url.description: Page of the listing on the akiya bank

description.description: Description of the property as shown on the akiya bank
